scope: Conditional service of an already ready frontier. Not closed-loop speculation.
source_decode_selection: First actual unpadded four-row cached-decode invocation with one query token per row.
source_output_control: Native allowed_token_ids singleton. No teacher hook.
tp1_row_and_depth: Select each independently from zero through three.
row_identity: Captured input_batch request order. Never assume submission order.
residency: Retain the original R4 model, all original parameters, and all4L cache slots.

lease.phase: After native generation completes, the driver has no unfinished request, and the worker has no execute_model_state.
lease.destination: Existing slot0 allocations. No new cache binding.
lease.protected: Every real page of all four source requests through the current token.
lease.lifetime: Exclusive fixture use until engine teardown. No subsequent serving call.
lease.snapshots: Capture all selected historical versions before any destination write.
lease.layout_limit: Reject interleaved layer arenas and overlapping original cache address ranges.

checks: Original selected-depth historical K and V
parity.cadence: Before timing, after every timed trial, and after the final trial.
parity.cross_rank_gate: All TP ranks must pass before timed trials continue.
parity.cross_tp_bitwise_equivalence: Not claimed. Each fixture checks its own native reference.

service.body: One working-input reset copy, all original physical layer bodies at slot0, and core.norm.
service.residual: Reset to None at pass entry. Keep every native norm, residual operation, and cast.
service.clocks: Rank-local CUDA events and host wall. No aligned DP4 or TP4 global makespan claim.
service.claim_limit: Eager physical service only. Native compiled/graph headroom is UNVALIDATED.

graph_limit: Native collective capture registration exists. Eager FA3 max_num_splits=0 is explicitly not graph compatible. No graph path is implemented.
